summary: Retest of the work-order dedup bug fix (admin Work Orders tab / sync removed_work_orders / removed_bills counters / admin status override survives sync / vendor read-only view / Sync Log tab) plus full regression sweep. All 41 backend tests pass. Confirmed via direct curl + UI screenshot that GET /api/work-orders returns exactly 3 work orders with 3 unique po_numbers and unique ids (A/E/Febrication/008/2025, A/E/Work/Fabrication/08-2026/27, P00020), GET /api/bills returns 3, and repeated POST /api/sync/arun is idempotent (12/3/3, removed_work_orders=0/removed_bills=0 on a clean state, counters present in the response schema). Admin Command Center Work Orders stat card reads 3 (screenshot evidence). Fixed 4 of my OWN stale browser-check assertions that no longer matched current (legitimate) app/data state, none were application bugs: admin-sync-idempotent (hardcoded '1' from an old 1-vendor/1-order/1-bill seed, now 12/3/3), sidebar-vendor-firm-identity (vendor's real contact_person on the upstream portal changed from 'Ragvendra Singh' to 'Upendra Singh' between iterations - data drift, confirmed via GET /api/vendors), vendor-data-real-mapping (asserted bill ref_no inside the table row testid, but the UI only ever rendered ref_no in the bill detail panel, never the row - fixed the assertion location), admin-create-user-flow (password reset UI was refactored to a modal Dialog with fixed testids admin-pw-new-input/admin-pw-confirm-input/admin-pw-save-button instead of the old per-email inline input naming scheme - legitimate UI change, not a regression). No application bugs found.
